description: Reads one public web page and returns its title, description and main text as Markdown (headings, links, lists), plus link counts. Reads only the page you name: no crawling of other pages, no JavaScript rendering, so pages that build their text in the browser may come back short. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

url.description: Full http or https address of a public page
